summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）检测与分割年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Swin UNETR in the Detection Segmentation area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Swin UNETR: Swin Transformers for Semantic Segmentation of Brain Tumors in MRI Images”. The page names Ali Hatamizadeh, Daguang Xu as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
